title: Unity Bank Appoints Sara M. Sooy and Alfred J. Gaburo to Board of Directors
summary: New directors bring extensive experience in government affairs, financial oversight, banking, real estate finance, and community leadership CLINTON, N.J., June 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Unity Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: UNTY), the parent company of Unity Bank, announced that its Board of Directors has voted to appoint Sara M. Sooy and Alfred J. Gaburo to the Unity Bank Board of Directors. Sooy brings significant banking, finance, governance, and public-sector leadership experience to the board. Her background includes public company audit committee service, credit risk evaluation, commercial real estate finance, enterprise risk governance, capital planning, and fiduciary oversight. She has held roles with Investors Bank and the New Jersey Economic Development Authority, and currently serves as a Somerset County Commissioner.
